name: MonarchLinkCard
title: LinkCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with Link(destination:), AsyncImage through MonarchRemoteImage, MonarchFavicon
summary: A preview of a shared link from data the app unfurled: picture, site, title and description as one link, with an optional remove button.
whenToUse: Under a message, post or comment that contains a link the app's server has unfurled, so people see where it leads before opening it.
whenNotToUse: For a plain link in text, use Link or Text with Markdown. For a record inside the app with its own actions, build a product card. LPLinkView (LinkPresentation) is the system alternative when the app lets the system fetch the preview itself.
api: init(_ title: String, url: URL, description: String? = nil, siteName: String? = nil, image: Image?, imageSize: CGSize? = nil, favicon: Image? = nil, isVideo: Bool = false, size: MonarchLinkCardSize = .md, dismissLabel: String? = nil, videoLabel: String? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

init(_ title: String, url: URL, description: String? = nil, siteName: String? = nil, imageURL: URL?, imageSize: CGSize? = nil, faviconURL: URL? = nil, isVideo: Bool = false, size: MonarchLinkCardSize = .md, dismissLabel: String? = nil, videoLabel: String? = nil, onDismiss: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

options.name: url
options.description: The link. Only http, https and mailto open; anything else shows the card as plain text.

options.name: description
options.description: The page description, up to two lines.

options.name: siteName
options.description: The site above the title; the host name without www by default.

options.name: image / imageURL
options.description: The page's picture, or nil for none. A URL is loaded with AsyncImage.

options.name: imageSize
options.description: The picture's natural size; its ratio is kept between 1.2 and 2.2, and 2.2 when unknown.

options.name: favicon / faviconURL
options.description: The site's icon; without it MonarchFavicon draws a letter tile.

options.name: isVideo
options.description: Draws a play mark on the picture and adds "Video" to the spoken name.

options.name: size
options.description: md: banner above the text. sm: thumbnail beside it.

options.name: dismissLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Remove the preview of" and the title.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Shows a remove button in the corner.

states.name: loading picture
states.description: A muted placeholder keeps the picture's space while AsyncImage loads; it stays if loading fails.

states.name: not a safe link
states.description: The card is shown as plain text and does not open.

states.name: dismissible
states.description: A remove button with a surface-coloured circle sits in the top trailing corner.

appearance: A MonarchCard (surface fill, subtle border). The site is caption text in the muted colour with a small favicon, the title body-strong text in the default colour, the description caption text in the muted colour. The picture has the control corner radius; its placeholder uses the muted background fill. The play mark is the inverse text colour on the inverse background. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web LinkCard opens in a new tab with rel attributes, has a footer slot, and comes with LinkCardList and LinkCardSkeleton. On iOS the link opens through the openURL environment (the app can intercept it); there is no footer (place product actions below the card); a list is a VStack of cards; and a skeleton is the card with redacted(reason: .placeholder). A failed picture keeps its placeholder instead of disappearing, per the Monarch image convention. Android ships the same MonarchLinkCard.
accessibility: A safe link is the standard Link, one element with the link role, read as the site, the title, the description and "Video" for a video.
A link that does not open is one plain element with the same spoken text.
The picture, the play mark and the favicon are hidden from VoiceOver.
The remove button is a separate element named "Remove the preview of" and the title, with a 44-point touch target.
Text scales with Dynamic Type; the thumbnail and play mark scale with it.
edgeCases: Long titles are limited to two lines and descriptions to two lines; VoiceOver reads them in full.
Very tall or very wide pictures are cropped to the 1.2 to 2.2 ratio range.
Without a site name and with a URL that has no host (mailto), the site line is left out.
Opening the link was not tried on a device; the card uses the standard Link.

    url: url,
    description: {{description}},
    siteName: {{siteName}},
    image: picture,
    imageSize: CGSize(width: {{image.width}}, height: {{image.height}})
)

    siteName: "Example Guides",
    image: picture,
    imageSize: CGSize(width: 1200, height: 630)
)
